reason: The independent validator rejected release of PGS005206 scores as total-body BMD (criteria V6b and V7; no retry allowed). The PGS Catalog trait fields for PGS005206 say only 'Bone mineral density' with no skeletal site; total body comes only from the linked source GWAS GCST005348 (Total body bone mineral density). The only catalogued evaluation is in a European paediatric cohort (Generation R, n=3470, mean age 9.77 years), and predictive validity cannot be assessed on the synthetic dosages. Do you approve treating PGS005206 as a total-body BMD score on the basis of the source GWAS and releasing the 20 raw scores in artifacts/prs_scores_1.csv with these limitations, or should the run stop without releasing results?
